_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: refresh_token and offline_access are both needed for a grant that survives the hour; Salesforce treats them as one capability but the connected app has to have it enabled.
Sandbox orgs authenticate against https://test.salesforce.com with the same paths. Using login.salesforce.com against a sandbox fails with an unhelpful invalid_grant.
The token response carries instance_url, and every subsequent API call must go to that host - not to login.salesforce.com.
The org must be API-enabled. That is what the eligibility badge on this connector is about: Essentials editions have no API access at all.

rate_limits.note: A daily API call allowance per org, not a per-second rate. Burning it affects everything else the org does, so batch with SOQL rather than looping records.
